english.title: Large brand owner, distributor fail to comply with packaging waste data reporting obligation - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a large producer subject to obligations as a brand distributor in regulation 17 of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, failed to report the information in Part 2 of, and paragraphs 11 to 13, 16, 17 and 23 of Schedule 1 to, those regulations to the Environment Agency every 6 months in accordance with that regulation and in such form and manner as the Environment Agency directed in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(1)(a) and (c) and 28(2)(b) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.

english.notes: This offence applies from the 1st April 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/359 extending the information to be reported under Schedule 1. This offence should be used from 01/04/2024. For the offence applying before this date, see H101354.
